description: POST /v1/apps/{app_name}/deploy_token mints a new deploy token (a FlyV1 macaroon scoped to the app) and returns it in `token`, but the spec marks nothing sensitive, so the SDK returned it as a plain string that prints and logs. Marked sensitive so it decodes to Redacted. Observed live 2026-10-09 on a throwaway app: the response body is `{ "token": "FlyV1 fm2_…" }`.
